default.title: Help mode active
default.description: Hover over an element (menu entry, button, table column, indicator …) to see an explanation. Click the question mark in the top-right to turn the mode off again.

nav:dashboard.title: Dashboard
nav:dashboard.description: Overview cockpit: portfolio value, P/L, day change, performance chart, health score, AI analysis card. Layout configurable via "Configure".

nav:portfolio.title: Portfolio
nav:portfolio.description: Manage positions: create, edit, delete. Also CSV import from brokers (Trade Republic, comdirect, IBKR …) and PDF report.

nav:watchlist.title: Watchlist
nav:watchlist.description: Watchlist — stocks you're interested in but don't yet hold. With trend sparkline, conviction score and 52W position.

nav:alerts.title: Alerts
nav:alerts.description: Price and indicator alerts: triggers an email (and web push, if enabled) once the threshold is hit. Checked every 15 min.

nav:insights.title: Insights
nav:insights.description: Curated AI analyses — AI track-record hit rate, strengths/weaknesses diagnosis, catalyst notes.

nav:chat.title: Chat
nav:chat.description: "Ask the Portfolio": natural-language chat with your own portfolio context. Streaming responses, consumes AI tokens.

nav:transactions.title: Transactions
nav:transactions.description: Full transaction history including individual buys and sells, grouped by ticker.

nav:rebalance.title: Rebalance
nav:rebalance.description: Define target allocation per bucket; tool computes concrete buys/sells to bring the portfolio back in line.

nav:risk.title: Risk analysis
nav:risk.description: Value-at-Risk, Monte Carlo simulation, historical stress tests (COVID, 2008, rate shock) and factor exposure.

nav:health.title: Portfolio health
nav:health.description: Grade A–F for your overall portfolio: diversification, cost structure, sector clusters, cash ratio, volatility profile.

nav:tax-report.title: Tax report
nav:tax-report.description: Realized gains/losses per German capital-gains tax logic (FIFO), dividend overview, withholding-tax breakdown.

nav:dividends.title: Dividends
nav:dividends.description: Dividend history of your positions, forecasted payouts, dividend yield, ex-dates.

nav:dividends-calendar.title: Dividend calendar
nav:dividends-calendar.description: Calendar view of all upcoming ex-dividend and payment dates for your positions + watchlist.

nav:calendar.title: Earnings calendar
nav:calendar.description: Upcoming quarterly earnings dates for your positions and watchlist tickers.

nav:market.title: Market radar
nav:market.description: What's moving right now? Wikipedia/Google attention spikes + top-20 news + AI idea generator for stocks you don't hold.

nav:macro.title: Macro & sentiment
nav:macro.description: Top-level market indicators — Reddit sentiment, Fear & Greed index, market breadth.

nav:macro-scenario.title: Macro scenarios
nav:macro-scenario.description: How does your portfolio react to specific macro scenarios (ECB +100bp, Brent $120, AI bubble pops)? AI evaluates each position individually, with FRED data as an anchor.

nav:screener.title: Screener
nav:screener.description: Multi-criteria filter over the stock universe: P/E, dividend yield, market cap, sector, region.

nav:breakout.title: Breakout
nav:breakout.description: Tickers currently breaking out of 52W highs/lows or violating Bollinger bands.

nav:discoveries.title: Discoveries
nav:discoveries.description: AI-driven suggestions based on your portfolio: similar stocks, missing sectors, ETF gaps.

nav:peer-compare.title: Peer compare
nav:peer-compare.description: Two stocks side-by-side: fundamentals, AI analysis of both, consensus recommendation.

nav:news-digest.title: AI news digest
nav:news-digest.description: Daily/weekly AI summary of your tickers' news — compressed to 5–10 sentences.

nav:track-record.title: AI track record
nav:track-record.description: How good were the AI recommendations? Hit rate (BUY → positive return, SELL → negative) and average return per model.

nav:backtest.title: Backtest
nav:backtest.description: Test technical strategies (RSI/MACD/SMA cross) against historical data; read Sharpe and max drawdown.

nav:magazine.title: Magazines
nav:magazine.description: PDF upload (e.g. Börse Online) → AI extracts recommendations + ratings.

nav:thesen.title: Investment theses
nav:thesen.description: Document your own theses on stocks — AI periodically checks whether the assumptions still hold.

nav:briefing.title: Weekly briefing
nav:briefing.description: Daily/weekly AI report: what changed, which risks are new, which opportunities?

nav:strategien.title: Strategies
nav:strategien.description: Pre-built investment strategies (dividend aristocrats, magic formula, quality income …) with rationale.

nav:glossar.title: Glossary
nav:glossar.description: Short, readable explanations of all financial terms used in the app.

nav:hilfe.title: Help & FAQ
nav:hilfe.description: Detailed documentation of all features, API-key guides, privacy notes.

nav:settings.title: Settings
nav:settings.description: Profile, security (password, 2FA), AI provider keys, notifications, theme/3D, push.

nav:help-toggle.title: Help mode
nav:help-toggle.description: When active, an info bar appears below the live ticker that explains features as you hover them.

btn:refresh.title: Refresh
btn:refresh.description: Fetches fresh prices, fundamentals and FX rates. Only useful while the market is open — otherwise the same data.

btn:customize.title: Configure
btn:customize.description: Activates config mode for the order and visibility of dashboard widgets. Saved in the browser.

btn:add-position.title: Add position
btn:add-position.description: Create a new position manually. Tip: same ticker + same purchase currency is automatically merged as a blended buy.

btn:csv-import.title: CSV import
btn:csv-import.description: Read a broker export — Trade Republic, comdirect, ING, IBKR and other formats are auto-detected.

btn:pdf-report.title: PDF report
btn:pdf-report.description: Print-ready summary of your portfolio — useful for your tax advisor or your own archive.

btn:ai-analyze.title: Run AI analysis
btn:ai-analyze.description: Sends fundamentals, news, Reddit buzz, Wikipedia spike, Google trends, Finnhub analytics and SEC filings to the AI model. Costs ~$0.01–$0.05.

btn:consensus.title: Run consensus
btn:consensus.description: Runs multiple AI providers in parallel and shows agreement/disagreement. Costs several times what a single analysis costs.

btn:run-tour.title: Replay tour
btn:run-tour.description: Plays the intro tour again — useful if you missed something or there have been updates.

btn:notifications.title: Notifications
btn:notifications.description: The bell opens the last 14 days of triggered alerts and new AI analyses. Red counter = unread.

btn:command-palette.title: Cmd+K search
btn:command-palette.description: Keyboard quick access (Cmd+K or Ctrl+K): open a page, run an action or jump to a ticker.

col:portfolio:ticker.title: Ticker
col:portfolio:ticker.description: Symbol + company name. Click opens the detail analysis page with chart, fundamentals and AI recommendation.

col:portfolio:shares.title: Shares
col:portfolio:shares.description: How many shares you hold. Savings plans can produce fractional shares.

col:portfolio:avg-price.title: Avg. cost
col:portfolio:avg-price.description: Blended cost across all buys (weighted average). The base-currency figure is shown on top, the purchase-currency figure below.

col:portfolio:current.title: Current
col:portfolio:current.description: Current price in base currency. If the stock trades in a different currency, the original price is shown underneath.

col:portfolio:trend.title: Trend (3M)
col:portfolio:trend.description: Sparkline of the last ~3 months. Green = current value above start value, red = below.

col:portfolio:today.title: Today
col:portfolio:today.description: Day change in percent. Green = positive, red = negative.

col:portfolio:value.title: Value
col:portfolio:value.description: Market value of this position in base currency — shares × current price.

col:portfolio:pnl.title: P/L
col:portfolio:pnl.description: Unrealized gain/loss in base currency and percent. Realized gains are in the tax report.

col:portfolio:weight.title: Weight
col:portfolio:weight.description: Share of this position in the total portfolio in percent. Warning sign at ~10–15 % concentration risk.

col:portfolio:actions.title: Actions
col:portfolio:actions.description: Edit (pencil) opens details for editing, Delete (trash) removes the position after confirmation.

col:watchlist:price.title: Price
col:watchlist:price.description: Current price in base currency, with original trading-currency price underneath if applicable.

col:watchlist:high.title: Distance to 52W high
col:watchlist:high.description: How far the current price is below the 52-week high in percent. 0 % = new high.

col:watchlist:low.title: Distance to 52W low
col:watchlist:low.description: How far the current price is above the 52-week low in percent.

col:watchlist:conviction.title: Conviction score
col:watchlist:conviction.description: AI confidence from your last saved stock analysis. Higher = clearer recommendation.

indicator:sma.title: SMA (Simple Moving Average)
indicator:sma.description: Average of the last N closing prices. Smooths prices. SMA50 vs SMA200 = classic trend signal (Golden/Death Cross).

indicator:ema.title: EMA (Exponential Moving Average)
indicator:ema.description: Exponentially weighted moving average — weights recent prices more heavily, reacts faster than SMA.

indicator:rsi.title: RSI (Relative Strength Index)
indicator:rsi.description: Oscillator 0–100. Above 70 = overbought (potential sell signal), below 30 = oversold (potential buy signal). Default period 14.

indicator:macd.title: MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence)
indicator:macd.description: Difference between two EMAs (12 and 26). MACD line crossing the signal line (EMA9) → trend-change indicator. Bullish cross = buy signal.

indicator:bollinger.title: Bollinger Bands
indicator:bollinger.description: SMA20 ± 2 standard deviations. Price leaving the upper band = volatility spike, often a mean-reversion setup.

indicator:atr.title: ATR (Average True Range)
indicator:atr.description: Average true range over N days — a measure of volatility in absolute price units. Useful for stop-loss sizing.

indicator:obv.title: OBV (On-Balance Volume)
indicator:obv.description: Cumulative volume, added/subtracted depending on whether the day closed up or down. Divergence from price signals trend breaks.

indicator:vwap.title: VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price)
indicator:vwap.description: Volume-weighted average price since the start of the day. Pros use VWAP as a "fair entry" reference.

indicator:stochastic.title: Stochastic Oscillator
indicator:stochastic.description: Position of the close relative to high/low of the last N days. Above 80 = overbought, below 20 = oversold.

badge:buy.title: BUY
badge:buy.description: Strongly positive AI recommendation — price target above current price, clear arguments. Still do your own due diligence.

badge:accumulate.title: ACCUMULATE
badge:accumulate.description: Accumulate: weaker form of BUY — buy in gradually rather than all-in.

badge:hold.title: HOLD
badge:hold.description: Hold: no strong arguments for buying or selling. Leave the position as-is.

badge:reduce.title: REDUCE
badge:reduce.description: Reduce: weaker form of SELL — trim the position rather than closing it.

badge:sell.title: SELL
badge:sell.description: Sell — the AI sees clear counter-arguments. Realized gains roll into the tax report.

feature:liveticker.title: Live ticker
feature:liveticker.description: Scrolling display of global indices (S&P 500, DAX, Nikkei …). Data is delayed 15 min (Yahoo).

feature:portfolio-health.title: Portfolio health score
feature:portfolio-health.description: A–F grade for your overall portfolio: diversification, cost structure, sector cluster, volatility.

feature:wiki-attention.title: Wikipedia attention
feature:wiki-attention.description: Daily Wikipedia pageviews as an attention proxy. Spike ratio = avg. last 7 days divided by the 30-day baseline. >1.5x = significantly more interest right now.

feature:google-trends.title: Google search interest
feature:google-trends.description: Relative search volume (0–100) and rapidly rising related queries. Spikes indicate news, catalysts or topic rotations.

feature:attention-radar.title: Attention radar
feature:attention-radar.description: Wikipedia + Google Trends spikes across your watchlist + portfolio. Tickers with unusual attention are listed at the top.

feature:news-feed.title: Top news
feature:news-feed.description: The 20 most recent Yahoo news for your tickers — deduplicated and sorted by recency.

feature:sentiment-commodities.title: Sentiment & commodities
feature:sentiment-commodities.description: Overview of risk indicators (VIX, 10Y yield, USD index, EUR/USD) and commodities/crypto (gold, silver, WTI, Brent, natural gas, Bitcoin, Ethereum). 5-min cache, all data from Yahoo.

feature:sector-heatmap.title: US sector heatmap
feature:sector-heatmap.description: 11 SPDR Select Sector ETFs with daily change as a heatmap. Green = sector up today, red = sector down. Click opens the ETF's detail analysis.

indicatorFallback.overlayYes: Overlay directly on the price chart.
